name: pomodoro
description: Pomodoro timer: a notification after a pomodoro without a break, and a note that lets Claude sum up the session if that helps.

sound.title: Chime
sound.description: Play a chime with each alert (macOS). You hear it through a Focus, and while the Claude tab is in front, where Ghostty shows the banner for a few seconds only.

emoji.title: Tomato emoji
emoji.description: Show 🍅 in the count, the status line, the toasts and the transcript note. Off, the footer count reads 'pomodoro 3 of 4 · 12/25m'.
